description: Feel inspired by titanium's lightweight, bright, and mesmerizing qualities with the T Line Urban from Brompton. With this sleek lightweight bike, you can experience the city in an immersive way. By choosing this nimble yet powerful model, you can keep focusing on your surroundings as your bike does all the work for you. From noticing the change in a breeze that signifies the entrance to a city to the unique sounds you only hear when riding, the T Line Urban lets you embrace metropolitan life completely. To get you around the city, this titanium folding bike includes 4-speed gears, which improve control and agility. Expertly engineered, this lightweight frame weighs 37% less than steel equivalents, improving the gearing elements and on-road positioning. Being able to say yes to every opportunity is made possible by the simple bike folding system, which means you can transition from two wheels to two feet in just 20 seconds. Also light to carry, you can move around with ease in a much better way than compared to traditional foldable bikes. Because of the shape of the handlebar, the front reflector needs to be secured to the diagonal part of the bars by the shifter.Precision engineering means you can tackle everything that comes your way. By feeling empowered thanks to the versatile T Line Urban, a more energetic and active way of life awaits you! Brompton can provide a reliable transport method; it's up to you to find your next adventure. Whichever horizon you choose to explore, with the T Line Urban lightweight folding bike by your side, a positive experience is guaranteed.
